pages.text: Read this before you step through any portal — every dimension carries unique mechanical modifiers on top of mob scaling, and entering unprepared is the most reliable way to die here.

pages.title: Tier 1–2 Dimensions
pages.text: $(bold)Overworld$() — Baseline. Champions spawn at standard rate.$(br2)$(bold)Twilight Forest$() — Persistent Darkness debuff underground. Boss-guarded progression — you cannot reach later zones without defeating previous zone bosses.$(br2)$(bold)Blue Skies$() — Elemental damage ignores standard armor. Magic resistance (Sorcery tree) is unusually valuable here.

pages.title: Tier 3 Dimensions
pages.text: $(bold)Undergarden$() — Constant Poison I. All mobs inflict Wither on hit (1s duration). Healing items 25% less effective.$(br2)$(bold)Deeper & Darker$() — Noise detection mechanic (KubeJS). Mob aggro radius scales with your armor sound. Sprint-walking in full iron is very loud.$(br2)$(bold)Nether$() — All mobs start aggro'd. No ambient neutral mobs. Lava damage increased 50%.

pages.title: Tier 4 Dimensions
pages.text: $(bold)The Aether$() (Deep Aether's biomes included) — thin air above y 180 (Weakness, unless your armour carries Aether Acclimation); vertigo when sprinting above y 200; one updraft slows a fall into the void. Its mobs move fast.$(br2)$(bold)The End$() — Three escalating zones. Outer Islands: manageable. Deep End: elite mobs, Void environmental damage. Dragon's Domain: the endgame. Ender Dragon scales progressively with each kill.$(br2)$(bold)Next: gear for the specific hazard — $(l:icraft:systems/enchantments)Custom Enchantments$(/l) has a counter for most of these.$()
